strings.name: Emma Walmsley
strings.role: Business executive · Former GSK chief executive
strings.summary: Walmsley developed consumer-brand experience at L’Oréal before joining GSK in 2010. Group CEO from 2017 to 2025, she redirected medicines and vaccines research and oversaw the consumer-health demerger. She also serves as a Microsoft independent director. In November 2026 HP announced her appointment as CEO, scheduled to start on 4 January 2027.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Led GSK and advanced strategic changes in pharmaceuticals, vaccines and consumer healthcare.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in June 1969 in Barrow-in-Furness, United Kingdom.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: MA in classics and modern languages, Oxford; previously attended St Swithun’s School.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Biopharmaceutical strategy
strings.highlights.h1.text: Reshaped GSK research and its portfolio around prescription medicines and vaccines.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Consumer-health demerger
strings.highlights.h2.text: Led the Haleon separation, creating a separately listed consumer-health business.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Future HP CEO appointment
strings.timeline.t1.text: HP announced her appointment effective 4 January 2027; she had not started by the cutoff.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Left GSK leadership
strings.timeline.t2.text: Ended CEO and director roles on 31 December; transition employment continued to September 2026.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Haleon demerger
strings.timeline.t3.text: GSK separated consumer healthcare and focused its structure on biopharmaceuticals.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Microsoft board
strings.timeline.t4.text: Joined Microsoft’s board as an independent director.
strings.timeline.t5.title: GSK chief executive
strings.timeline.t5.text: Became group CEO in April, overseeing medicines, vaccines and consumer businesses.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Consumer-health CEO
strings.timeline.t6.text: Became chief executive of GSK Consumer Healthcare.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Global consumer-health leadership
strings.timeline.t7.text: Advanced from Europe to president of worldwide consumer healthcare.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joined GSK
strings.timeline.t8.text: Became president of European consumer healthcare after her L’Oréal career.
strings.timeline.t9.title: L’Oréal China
strings.timeline.t9.text: Moved to Shanghai to lead L’Oréal’s Chinese consumer-products business.
